startup.notes: First attempt with 'uv run python main.py' failed due to pygame build dependency issue (missing MSYS2/pacman on Windows). Second attempt using shared venv with pre-installed pygame succeeded.

execution.notes: Application launched successfully and ran without crashes for the duration of the test. The game runs as a GUI application with no console output, which is standard behavior for pygame applications.

observations: The game uses pygame for rendering and input handling
No console output is produced during execution
The game appears to be a physics-based block stacking game
Process memory usage was approximately 33MB during runtime
The application runs in GUI mode (headless execution would require display or virtual display)
notes: The application runs successfully when pygame is pre-installed. The dependency installation via uv failed on this system due to missing MSYS2 build tools, but this is a build-time issue, not a runtime issue.
